name: local-whisper-mcp-poc
description: Transcribes audio files on this machine with Whisper. The audio never leaves the machine.

tools.name: transcribe
tools.description: Transcribes an audio file on this machine with Whisper.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Reports the device, the loaded model, and the seconds left before the idle model is released.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model name in the models folder, for example large-v3-turbo-q5_0 or base.

language.title: Default language
language.description: Two-letter language code, or auto to detect it.

runtime.title: Runtime
runtime.description: auto, cpu, vulkan, or cuda. Unavailable GPU runtimes fall back to the CPU.

idle_minutes.title: Idle minutes
idle_minutes.description: Minutes without calls before the model is released from memory.
